title: The Humanist Ulrich von Hutten
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: Ulrich von Hutten (1488-1523), Renaissance-Reformation publisher and ardent champion of German nationalism, has previously been characterized as a bitter and vehement political satirist. From this concise, critical survey of his comic writing a more balanced, congenial image of Hutten emerges.
